name: NGC 5011C (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5011C, a dwarf galaxy in the Centaurus A group, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc5011c-hubble
story: A faint dwarf galaxy once thought to be a distant giant, it only appears to pair on the sky with NGC 5011B, which lies far beyond in the Centaurus cluster.
